strings.cin.c3p2.radio.ru: (Russian) …Annex C: goods and escorted persons pass the Line…
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.de: (German) …Annex C: goods and escorted goods pass the Line without stopping.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.alexei.base: Escorted persons. In German they put it differently.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.alexei.cafe: She never came to the café. I paid for two glasses of tea.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.alexei.alone: I wanted to search alone. Now she’s writing to me.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.konrad.base: Escorted goods. I have heard the word three times today.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.konrad.share: I showed him Elena’s note; he showed me a train. Now she is writing to us both.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.konrad.search: Her coat was still in the cloakroom when I left. Ticket 27.
strings.cin.c3p2.radio.konrad.report: Kessler listened and nodded. Nothing more.
strings.cin.c3p2.halves.split: Each carries his own language home – and the names written in it.
strings.cin.c3p2.halves.swap: He carries Pjotr’s name across his border. I carry his people across mine.
strings.cin.c3p2.halves.elena: The list is in a coat, ticket 27. If she comes back, she will find it.
strings.cin.c3p2.halves.plan_kept: In my coat pocket: sheet seven. Drawn by K. Adler.
strings.cin.c3p2.halves.plan_burnt: Sheet seven has burnt. I drew it all the same.
